title: AiGovOps Beacon receipt
description: The canonical signed evidence receipt every AiGovOps gate emits. Verifiable offline with the ed25519 public key. Frozen 2026-08-09 as the one-format contract (Phase 2, anoint revive). Any system that emits or verifies a receipt MUST match this exactly.

schema.description: Format identifier. Bump the trailing version only on a breaking change.

gate.description: The gate that issued the receipt (e.g. "beacon").

issuedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the receipt was signed.

evidenceHash.description: Lowercase-hex SHA-256 over the canonical form of the evidence. The payload itself is never included.

signature.description: base64 ed25519 signature over the canonical body (every field except signature).
